title: Kaal Kare So
desc: The common human problem of postponing one's tasks is very humorously explained by Javed Akhtar in this episode.

title: Sukh Sajjan
desc: Javed Akhtar says to understand the good in life one must experience the bad. One understands the value of love and relationships when it starts to part ways.

title: Hoye Na Karaj
desc: Javed Akhtar says nobody is indispensable in this world. One must remember that work and everything else will continue to happen whether he/she contributes or not.

desc: Javed Akhtar explains the concept of having a conscience and deflecting from moral compass and running away from responsibilities is wrong. He says awareness is a burden if not implemented upon.

desc: Some people think all problems happen to them but is it true or is it just a perspective? Javed Akhtar shares his thoughts on the same.
